blocks.html: Anchoring to concrete shall be in accordance with ACI 318 as amended in Section 1908, and applies to cast-in (headed bolts, headed studs and hooked J- or L-bolts), post-installed expansion (torque-controlled and displacement-controlled), undercut and adhesive anchors.
